name: @rido/pricing
description: RIDO commission and payout math. Pure, dependency-free, runtime-agnostic.
comment: No dependencies and no devDependencies, on purpose. This package is imported by a bundler (apps/web), by Deno (supabase/functions), and by a browser tool (tools/pilot-model). Adding a dependency breaks at least one of them. Test tooling comes from the consuming workspace.

scripts.test: if find src -name '*.test.ts' -print -quit | grep -q .; then find src -name '*.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 node --test --experimental-strip-types; else echo 'No src/*.test.ts files yet - nothing to run.'; fi
